newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended firmer around C$1.3595 (US$0.7355) on Tuesday from Monday's close at C$1.3618 (US$0.7343) with a quiet overnight session expected * Canada unit traded within a narrow range on Tuesday ahead of U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony before the Senate Banking Committee on Wednesday.
Greenspan is scheduled to deliver the first part of his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony before the Senate Banking Committee on Wednesday. The second leg will be delivered on March 5.
"If he's neutral on rates it may be good for the Canada (dollar) initially," the trader said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.2290 marks from Monday's close at 1.2280 marks and fell to 89.32 yen from Monday's 89.67 yen.
